opening: I have pain in my left eye.
Both the blurred vision and the eye pain came on suddenly a week ago.
I can barely see out of my left eye.
I'm very short-sighted, about minus 8.5 in both eyes.

opening.text: My vision has gone blurred and I have pain in my left eye. Both of these came on suddenly a week ago. I can barely see out of my left eye. I have chronic kidney failure and high blood pressure, and I'm very short-sighted, about minus 8.5 in both eyes.
